title: Preserve failed Worker handoff Notes from the outcome-selecting current-attempt packet
outcome: A Failed Worker packet followed by plain assistant text retains its current-attempt handoff/test Notes, or reports unavailable without falsely claiming the child supplied none.
acceptance: A focused regression covers a current-attempt Failed packet with Git/native-outcome Notes followed by a plain trailing chunk, and retains the appropriate Notes without reading a previous attempt.
Idle scan-back and stricter Error-state selection remain distinct and no current-attempt attribution or recovery decision is weakened.
